subject: [Atlas] Engineering status — week of Aug 25
body_preview: Migration script hit 82% of prod tables. Two blockers surfaced (see below).
body_content:
Weekly engineering status — Project Atlas

Progress
 • Migration script now handles 82% of prod tables (up from 61% last week).
 • CI pipeline green on the atlas-migrate branch for 4 consecutive runs.
 • Shadow-read comparison job caught 3 subtle schema divergences — all fixed.

Blockers
 1. `payments.subscription_events` has an implicit collation we didn’t catch. Rohit is drafting a fix; ETA Tue.
 2. Legal has not signed off on the data-at-rest change for the EU shard. Sarah is following up.

Next week
 • Ship shadow-write path behind flag.
 • Load-test rehearsal on staging.

Happy to discuss any of this Monday.

Marcus

subject: Blocker: subscription_events collation mismatch — need review
body_preview: Draft PR up. Migration will silently drop rows without an ORDER BY change. Please review before Mon.
body_content:
Hi,

As mentioned in standup — `payments.subscription_events` has an implicit `utf8mb4_general_ci` collation in the source that our target defaults to `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`. Migration will silently drop rows on the dedup step because the equality semantics differ.

Draft PR: https://github.acme.co/atlas/pull/412

The fix normalizes collation at the SELECT layer. I’d appreciate a review before Monday’s sync so we can talk about it (or ship it) live.

Rohit

subject: Re: shadow-write flag design — any thoughts?
body_preview: Circling back on the flag-shape question from Wed — leaning toward per-table but wanted your read.
body_content:
Hey,

Circling back on the shadow-write flag question we left open on Wednesday.

I’m leaning per-table (`atlas.shadow_write.<table>`) rather than a single global flag — lets us stage the rollout table by table and back out cleanly if one misbehaves.

Downside: more flags to clean up post-migration.

What’s your read? Want to lock this before Monday so Rohit can wire it up early week.

Marcus
